name: What is the process for exterior window trim repair by Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for exterior window trim repair by Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for exterior window trim repair begins with a thorough inspection to assess the damage. We then provide a detailed estimate and project plan. Once approved, our team carefully removes damaged sections, prepares the surface, installs new trim pieces or repairs existing ones, and finishes with proper sealing and painting to match your home's aesthetic. We focus on meticulous preparation to ensure the longevity of the repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves inspection, detailed estimate, careful removal of damaged parts, repair or installation, and finishing.
